subject.title: Feature Request: Slack-Style @Mention Autocomplete in Control UI Chat

question: Should @agent autocomplete extend the existing slash/composer suggestion model using `agents.list`, introduce a dedicated `agents.directory` plus rich-chip editor/API, or wait for a broader shared composer-suggestion design with custom terms?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing composer behavior and possible Gateway protocol surface; automation cannot safely choose the permanent editor model or whether a parallel agent metadata API should exist.

options.title: Scope Shared Composer Suggestions
options.body: Use the current slash-menu/composer path as the base and add API surface only after proving `agents.list` lacks required metadata.

options.title: Approve Dedicated Mentions API
options.body: Treat `agents.directory` and rich mention chips as a new Control UI/API direction requiring accessibility, IME, paste, serialization, and history-rendering proof.

options.title: Defer To Broader UX Planning
options.body: Keep composer suggestions slash-only until maintainers scope @agent and custom-term autocomplete together.

recommendation.title: Scope Shared Composer Suggestions
recommendation.body: Use the current slash-menu/composer path as the base and add API surface only after proving `agents.list` lacks required metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest combined signal from adjacent composer-suggestion triage and slash UX feature history.
